**wl-clipboard** provides command-line copy and paste for Wayland, running natively on your jailbroken device on the iosc Wayland compositor.

This is a real native arm64 build cross-compiled for rootless iOS. It ships two small tools, `wl-copy` and `wl-paste`, that read and write the compositor clipboard so you can move text and data between terminal programs and graphical apps.

- `wl-copy` sends standard input to the clipboard
- `wl-paste` writes the clipboard to standard output
- Works with any format the compositor advertises
- Native Wayland, no X11 required

Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`). Use it inside an Xios desktop session running the iosc compositor.

## 2.2.1  ·  2026-07-02
- First release: wl-clipboard 2.2.1 cross-compiled for rootless iOS
- Ships wl-copy and wl-paste for the iosc compositor clipboard
